name: index_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 5-minute return exceeds 0.2% (~15+ spot points), large institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms working directional buy (or sell) mandates are typically only 40-60% filled — their remaining unfilled lots continue pushing the index in the same direction for the next 30-90 seconds. At 5-second resolution, we detect this inflection point as the 5-minute return threshold is breached and the 1-minute return confirms the same direction (ruling out stale momentum that has already reversed), then buy ATM calls (CE) or puts (PE) to ride the second leg of institutional flow before exhaustion.

indicators.name: ret_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute return — same time window as the original (5 bars × 1-min = 5 min, here 60 bars × 5s = 5 min). This is a FIXED TIME WINDOW, not a scaled lookback. Captures exactly the same institutional order-flow cycle the original measured, at 5s precision. A 5-minute window is the natural TWAP slice size for most large orders.

indicators.name: ret_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute confirmation return. Required to avoid entering when 5-minute momentum is stale and already reversing. If the last 60 seconds disagree with the 5-minute trend, the institutional flow has likely already completed its second leg — skip the entry. Chosen at 12 bars (1 min) because ATM option premiums have delta ~0.5 and need at least 1 minute of directional pressure to produce a meaningful premium move above cost.

buy_ce.confirmation: Both 5-min and 1-min momentum must agree to rule out stale entries

buy_pe.confirmation: Both 5-min and 1-min momentum must agree to rule out stale entries

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = 8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. If the index retraces 8 spot points against the position within 30 seconds of entry, the institutional flow has reversed or completed — the thesis is wrong. 8 spot pts is the typical 1-standard-deviation 5-second range on NIFTY during trending sessions.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = 14 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. The trigger is a 0.2% (~15 pt) 5-minute move; continuation averages ~50-60% of the prior impulse (7-9 pts) based on NIFTY institutional TWAP residuals. 7 pts captures the lower end conservatively at 1:1.75 R:R. Larger targets risk the EOD reversal window.

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX is low-signal for this 5-minute momentum thesis
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST — skip first 5 minutes (09:15-09:20) to avoid pre-open noise
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume at 5s is noisy, excluded
filters.trend_filter: ret_12 direction confirms ret_60 direction (built into entry conditions)

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — institutional TWAP patterns are well-known; crowding may compress edge over 12-24 months

adaptation_notes: Original traded Nifty50 individual stocks using the NIFTY index 5-min return as a signal for beta-following. Here we cut out the middle layer — instead of hoping individual stocks follow the index, we trade the index options directly. The core signal (ret_60 > 0.20%) is unchanged. Added ret_12 confirmation layer: at 5-second resolution we can see if momentum has already stalled before entering, which was invisible on 1-minute bars. Time window is compressed from 1-10 bars (1-10 min) to 24 bars (120s) because index option delta decay at ATM is significant beyond 2 minutes at typical 5-minute momentum levels.
weaknesses: On low-volatility sideways days, the 0.2% threshold may not be breached at all, giving zero trades
Signal fires frequently during opening 30 minutes when institutional TWAP orders are largest — fills may have wider spreads than assumed
NIFTY momentum at 5-second scale has very thin profit margin vs cost: a 4-7 option point target requires ~8-14 spot point move in 30-120 seconds, which only happens ~30-40% of the time after signal
ret_12 confirmation filter may over-filter on choppy trending days where 1-min corrections interrupt 5-min trends
